custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, whose description contains the words NOT TRACKED, so the search also matches it on its description.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, whose part number, description and tags contain neither word, so the search has a part it must leave out.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with ZZ, so a Part Number sort from Z to A lists them at the top of the results.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154774-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154774-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the parts the words match.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed, and its Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked".
  • Part B is listed: its description matches the words.
  • Part C is not listed, although parts A and B with the same ZZ start are.

Step 3:

  • Parts A and B are listed and part C is not: upper and lower case make no difference.

Step 4:

  • Parts A and B are listed and part C is not: the spaces before and after the word make no difference.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S6-R1: “Typing "not tracked", "not" or "tracked" in the Inventory search returns the untracked parts, together with every part those words match on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields. Upper and lower case, and spaces before and after the term, do not matter.”
